title: Required document presence
source: md/rules.json compliance_rules[RULE-DOC-01] (status proposed_unverified, rule_type document_inventory, source_refs SRC-APH-2024-27/SRC-PRD-26262, applicability requires_official_mapping, APH cl. 2.3.4a,b as cited) + md/1_PRD.md FR-06 line 183 ('Confirm Affidavit 2 and DSC-signed docs; list missing items as deficiency draft') and the RULE-DOC-01 row at line 145 (outcome 'Deficiency candidate') + md/2_ARCHITECTURE.md line 117 ('DSC verification: stub') and md/0_MASTER_PROMPT.md line 103.
precedence_note: A concrete missing document beats an unknown checklist: a case whose Annexure-2 list is not transcribed but has no affidavit at all still has a definite deficiency to raise (FR-06), while the untranscribed inventory is reported as a needs-review leg beside it. md/rules.json defines the four outcomes but not their order, so this order is prototype policy, labelled here.
human_review: Required before issuing a formal deficiency.

inventory.note: The required-document inventory is the Phase 4.2 Annexure-2 checklist: only a transcribed category can answer, and an untranscribed or unknown list is REVIEW REQUIRED — never an empty all-clear (PRD s19 Q8 open).

affidavit_2.note: PLACEHOLDER MAPPING — the prototype's upload vocabulary has one generic 'affidavit' document type and cannot tell Affidavit 1/2/3 apart, so the mapping from 'Affidavit 2' (FR-06) to that slot is an assumption, not a recorded rule. No affidavit at all => missing (FR-06 certainly not met); an affidavit present => satisfied but unconfirmed (confirmed:false, needs review) until the numbered-affidavit mapping is recorded from an official source.

dsc.note: DSC verification is a stub in this prototype (md/2_ARCHITECTURE.md line 117; md/0_MASTER_PROMPT.md line 103) and no signature field exists on Document or ExtractedField. No signature data can be evaluated, so this leg ALWAYS answers needs review — never passed, never failed — and it never gates anything.

inventory_unavailable_note: md/rules.json defines 'document_inventory_unavailable: PROCESSING FAILED' for the case where the inventory itself cannot be read (e.g. a portal-fed inventory). With the local documents table as the source it is not reachable today; the outcome is kept in the vocabulary (and pinned to md/rules.json by a test) rather than silently dropped.
note: Advisory pre-check (DEC-0003): it lists candidates for an officer to review and may stage them as DRAFT deficiencies — the institution never sees a draft, nothing is issued, and no case is ever blocked or moved by this rule. md/rules.json itself records that human review is required before issuing a formal deficiency.
